episodes.title: Bananas
episodes.summary: After a failed drug bust, Sam and Kelly discover they're after the same dealer, forcing them to team up to take down a major Stockwood player.

episodes.title: Dealz
episodes.summary: Sam calls on Kelly's undercover skills when she gets a lead on a gun-dealing dollar store. But when Kelly's cover is blown, Sam's forced to get out of her comfort zone to expose the supplier.

episodes.title: Nuts
episodes.summary: With an informant's life on the line; Kelly enlists Sam's help in raiding a Stockwood stash house.

episodes.title: Feathers
episodes.summary: With a promotion in her sights, Sam recruits Kelly for a high-stakes sting that will get them one step closer to catching the Bowen Brothers; when Sam's power play takes an unexpected turn, it puts Kelly in unforeseen danger.

episodes.title: Kids
episodes.summary: Kelly enlists Elliot's help to investigate an MDMA dealer in his school; Sam's investigation into a father's missing guns takes a turn; she's surprised by who gets caught in the crossfire.

episodes.title: Guns
episodes.summary: When a cooler full of guns puts Sam and Kelly on the trail of 77 more black-market firearms, the pair find themselves in a life-or-death situation.

episodes.title: Ritz
episodes.summary: With Sam's promotion on the line; Sam and Kelly stake out an auto body shop, hoping to reel in Stockwood's last big fish.

episodes.title: Flowers
episodes.summary: Tracking the source of a new MDMA brings Sam and Kelly into the unlikely world of flower deliveries; they narrow in on a new Stockwood player.

episodes.title: Gliders
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of their shocking discovery, Sam and Kelly embark on a border-crossing mission to take down the new Stockwood boss.

episodes.title: Jellybeans
episodes.summary: Sam and Kelly are forced to team up with the enemy to take down an even bigger threat; the undercover sting takes a dangerous turn; Sam and Kelly must give their best performances yet to escape with their lives.

episodes.title: Pencil Skirts
episodes.summary: Sam and Kelly take their partnership to new heights when they go undercover as flight attendants to infiltrate a Central American gang's drug route.

episodes.title: Plastic Teeth
episodes.summary: Sam and Kelly investigate the origin of a 3D gun used to shoot a police officer. As a last resort, they team up with Kelly's ex-boyfriend to get ahead of their lead suspect.

episodes.title: Dirty Laundry
episodes.summary: When Elliot and Jackie return from a road trip across the border, trouble follows them, wreaking havoc on Sam and Kelly's search for who shot a police officer.

episodes.title: Dog Treats
episodes.summary: Sam and Kelly's friendship is put to the test when they're forced to work with Kelly's ex-boyfriend, whose intel gives them their biggest lead yet on the pink cocaine and 3D guns.

episodes.title: Rubber Lining
episodes.summary: Kelly and Sam pursue different leads to exonerate an innocent teen accused of shooting their colleague; both investigations wind up informing the Coyote case in an unexpected way.

episodes.title: Life Jacket
episodes.summary: Naz goes undercover as shady smuggler Scarborough Stu to infiltrate the Coyotes via Will French. Sam and Kelly must act fast when Will's sister Adeline shows up, unexpectedly jeopardizing Naz's cover.

episodes.title: Pigeon Party
episodes.summary: Naz gets in deeper with the Coyotes, earning him an invite to Adeline's party, but when Naz finds himself in hot water, it's up to Sam and Kelly to pull him out before events get deadly.

episodes.title: Bug Spray
episodes.summary: With Michaels eager to take over their Coyote case, Sam and Kelly set off on an impromptu road trip to cottage country in a last-ditch effort to find their suspected drug kingpin.

episodes.title: Crystal Ball
episodes.summary: In pursuit of Adeline French, Sam and Kelly find themselves at the doorstep of a fraudulent psychic, who opens their eyes to mysteries they need to solve within their own lives.

episodes.title: Worm Drive
episodes.summary: With key evidence destroyed and suspicions of a dirty cop amid their case, Sam and Kelly participate in workplace mental health training to try to get to the bottom of it.

episodes.title: Chipped Nails
episodes.summary: Scrambling to get back on the job, Sam and Kelly's mission to find the real corrupt cop becomes personal when Sam's career is put on the line and Kelly's reputation is at stake.

episodes.title: Ribbon Cutting
episodes.summary: Sam and Kelly zero in on the Coyote alliance as they prepare to infiltrate a ribbon-cutting ceremony at a new private airport terminal that is suspected of transporting more than rich passengers.

episodes.title: Always a Bridesmaid
episodes.summary: After long eight months apart, Sam and Kelly reunite on a high-stakes assignment, going undercover as bridesmaids to secure a murder confession.

episodes.title: Ten Thousand Steps
episodes.summary: Sam and Kelly investigate a ketamine theft at an animal sanctuary as Naz and Nathan work to catch the dealer of a dangerous new synthetic drug.

episodes.title: Red Velvet Durag
episodes.summary: A surge in gun violence in a community undergoing gentrification brings Sam and Kelly to a Caribana mas camp. Tensions rise when a shooting leaves them searching for those responsible.

episodes.title: Bare Naked Ladies
episodes.summary: Kelly is put on the purple rain case with Nathan, leaving Sam in a vulnerable situation when she has to go undercover with Naz's girlfriend at a nudist colony.

episodes.title: Fish Called David
episodes.summary: Sam weasels her way into an undercover play as a koi aficionado; Kelly forges a crucial new gang connection.

episodes.title: Spin Me Round
episodes.summary: Sam, Kelly, Naz, and Nathan stage a purple rain take-down at a roller-skating rink; on her way there, Kelly is shaken by an eye-opening altercation with the police.

episodes.title: Hot Pepper Jelly
episodes.summary: Kelly goes to Guelph on her own in search of the chemist behind purple rain, as Sam's health issues have her trailing behind; Sam finds Kelly trapped in an explosive situation.

episodes.title: Badge Bitch Party
episodes.summary: After learning that the entire purple rain operation has been compromised, Sam and Kelly drown their frustrations in work, discovering the best way to solve the case is to go back to the beginning.

episodes.title: Right Hand Red
episodes.summary: Sam and Kelly set up an elaborate fake informant operation to uncover incriminating evidence in the purple rain case but the play is derailed when Naz becomes the prime suspect in a murder.

episodes.title: Creatures of Habit
episodes.summary: The OCE team works together to exonerate Naz and stop purple rain. Kelly and Nathan go undercover. Sam talks to an old friend. Naz scrambles to remember a detail that can help arrest a killer.
